base.description: USW-Pro-24-PoE - 24 Gigabit RJ45 ports (16 PoE+, 8 PoE++), two 1/10G SFP+ ports, internal 450 W AC supply, USP RPS DC input. The data sheet lists one model and no other part number.

description: Ubiquiti USW-Pro-24-PoE (UniFi Switch Pro 24 PoE) is a fixed 1RU Layer 2 switch. Its front carries 24 Gigabit RJ45 ports in two stacked rows, 16 PoE/PoE+ and 8 60 W PoE++, two 1/10G SFP+ ports in a column beside them, a 1.3 inch touchscreen on the left and a recessed factory-reset button. The rear carries the AC power inlet and the USP RPS DC input for an external redundant supply. The 450 W supply is internal, so it is part of the chassis and not a bay.

gaps.note: The data sheet gives weights with and without mounting brackets and no figure for them, and no install guide is held. No ear position is stated, none is shipped as default and no kit is listed.
gaps.wanted: The install guide (dl.ui.com/qig/usw-pro-24-poe) for the ear positions and the one shipped, and the maker's rail kits if any apply.

gaps.note: The data sheet's LED table gives the Ethernet and SFP+ lamps a function ("PoE Speed/link/activity", "Speed/link/activity") and no colour or state. The pictures show green lamps on the jacks and white triangles on the cages; no state is written beyond the component's own vocabulary.

The data sheet says RPS "Status" and no state, so what the lamp means is not known; only its colour (blue) is read, off the community drawing. The legend beside the RPS lamp (USP RPS, OFF, ON) is read off the same drawing at the limit of its resolution, and what the OFF and ON marks are for is not said.
gaps.wanted: The install guide's rear panel and LED table.

gaps.note: The numerals under and over the jacks are not legible in any picture held, so the order is inferred (see provenance port-numbering) and the mark on ports 17 to 24 is not drawn. The line under the screen reads "USW Pro" and nothing more is legible after it.

airflow.note: not stated by the data sheet or the page. The NetBox entry says front to rear, and the slots on both faces are vents, but no fan is shown, so no airflow is claimed on the chassis (see the gap).

built-in-power-and-fans.note: Data sheet, Hardware: "Power supply: AC/DC, internal, 450W" and "Power method: Universal input, 100-240V AC, 50/60Hz; USP RPS DC input, 52V DC, 7.69A / 11.5V DC, 2.61A". The supply is internal, so it is part of the chassis, not a bay and not a component. The sheet says nothing of fans; the slots along the top edges of both faces are drawn as vents and no fan is placed (see the gap).

chassis.note: Data sheet, Mechanical: "442.4 x 285.4 x 43.7 mm (17.4 x 11.2 x 1.7")", read as width, depth and height (the 1U height settles which is which; the maker's page prints 442 x 285 x 44 mm in the same order). Weight "Without mounting brackets: 4.3 kg (9.5 lb) With mounting brackets: 4.4 kg (9.7 lb)"; the weights imply the mounting brackets ship with the switch, but no contents list is held. The page's rack depth is 400 to 1200 mm ("Supported Rack Depth"). The elevation drawing shows no ears, and the body is modelled as 442.4 wide, the sheet's own figure, not the 19 inch 482.6.

colour.note: #c8cacc on both Ubiquiti devices, chosen and not measured: six readings of the plain metal, taken as medians away from ports and text, do not agree. This switch's community front elevation (ubiquiti-unifi-switch-24-pro-poe-gen2.front.png, the plate left of the ports, x 120 to 520, y 30 to 95 px) reads #e3e5e6; its rear elevation (the plate between the socket and the label, x 300 to 880, y 40 to 95 px) reads #c8cacb. The UDM-Pro's community front elevation (x 100 to 480, y 25 to 85 px) reads #d3d2d5 and its rear (x 300 to 850, y 40 to 95 px) #cbcacd. The data sheet photograph of this switch (x 220 to 420, y 722 to 775 of the 1500 px picture) reads #acadaf, its plate being in shade, and the UDM-Pro's (x 290 to 470, same rows) #c9c9cb. The two rear elevations and the UDM-Pro photograph lie within three levels of #c8cacc; the two front elevations are lighter and this switch's photograph darker. #c8cacc is also the grey of the silver chassis already in the library. Every reading is an estimate of a lit picture, not of the paint.

display.note: Data sheet, Hardware: "LCM display: (1) 1.3" touchscreen"; the same part and wording as the UDM-Pro's, so both use ubiquiti/lcm-touchscreen-1-3@1. Its size is estimated from the elevation. The legend under the screen is drawn as "USW Pro" (see legend); the brand mark beside it is not drawn, and its logo zone stays reserved.

front-layout.note: estimated - read off the community elevation at the scales under gate-1. Two shells of six columns; column step 13.97 and one 2.9 mm extra gutter between the sixth and seventh columns; the first jack's left edge at 213.1; the upper row at 7.8 and the lower at 22.3 (14.5 apart, read as the jacks' tops at 20.7 and 58.3 px); the two SFP+ cages on the registry cell (14.25 wide, 15.0 row pitch) at 405.8 and 7.6; the touchscreen's dark square 23 mm across at 5.5, 9.2; the reset pinhole at 426.2, 37.2. The five horizontal slots along the top edge are read off the same drawing and are drawn as plain bars that declare `vent` (see vents). The data sheet photograph agrees on every count: 12 columns, 2 rows, 2 cages, the screen at the left end.

gate-1.note: The data sheet photograph is oblique (the right-hand side wall is in view and the face is foreshortened), so it is not measured: it supplies counts, the arrangement, lamp places and printed legends. The measuring drawing is the community front elevation, 1179 x 113 px. Its aspect, 10.43, is 3 percent from the body's 442.4 / 43.7 = 10.12, so x and y are not one scale: x is taken at 2.673 px per mm, which is the width scale 2.665 corrected so that the registry RJ45 pitch (13.97 mm) closes on the measured column pitch (37.7 px) with the 6 + 6 gang gutter of 2.9 mm read as the 45 px between columns 6 and 7; y is taken at 2.586 px per mm from the height. Every position is estimated to about 1.5 mm in x and 1 mm in y. Laid over the render at matched scale, the drawing's last jack column stands about 2 mm right of this model's (a pitch of 14.1 against 13.97 would close it) and the SFP+ column about 0.8 mm; the registry pitch was kept, because that error is inside the drawing's own blur.

jacks.note: Each jack carries one lamp, at its upper right corner on the upper row and its lower right corner on the lower row (green in both pictures), so the upper row is turned 180 (latch up) and the lower row takes the lamp-right skin of common/rj45-ganged-link@1. The sheet names the lamp as "Ethernet: PoE Speed/link/activity" and gives no colour or state, so the jack keeps the component's own link and activity vocabulary and no state is invented (see the gap).

legend.note: estimated - the legend under the screen reads "USW Pro" on the data sheet strip, with the brand mark to its right (the mark is not drawn: the logo zone stays reserved). It is read at the limit of the picture: the community elevation shows the same line as an unreadable smear of the same length. It is drawn as plain text at 2.4 mm, the height the strip's letters have beside the 23 mm screen.

logo.note: The brand mark beside the legend under the screen on the front, and the brand wordmark and mark on the rear label, are not drawn: three `logo-zone` regions are reserved where the elevations show them (the two on the rear named logo-zone and logo-zone-2).

port-numbering.note: The numerals are 1 to 2 px high in every picture held, so the order is read as a pattern and not as digits: one numeral above each upper jack and one below each lower jack, each column's pair running up then down, the SFP+ pair marked above and below the cages, and the 17 to 24 mark matching the PoE++ group. The usual UniFi order is read from that: odd numbers on the upper row (1, 3, 5 ... 23), even numbers on the lower row (2, 4 ... 24), then 25 above and 26 below the SFP+ cages. This is the figure most worth a second reading with the install guide.

ports.note: Data sheet, Hardware: "(24) GbE RJ45 ports (2) 1/10G SFP+ ports"; PoE interface "(16) PoE/PoE+ (Pins 1, 2+; 3, 6-) (8) 60W PoE++ ...". Which ports are PoE++ is not in the sheet: the NetBox entry puts PoE++ on ports 17 to 24 and the elevation drawing prints a mark after the numerals of 17 to 24 (and none on 1 to 16), so ports 17 to 24 carry `poe: PoE++` and 1 to 16 `poe: PoE+`, read as photo-measured, not stated by a sheet.

rear-layout.note: estimated - read off the community rear elevation (1271 x 126 px, 2.873 px per mm across from the body width, 2.883 down). The USP RPS socket is 63.8 x 18.5 at 18.0, 19.3, with its USP CONNECT legend under it; the AC inlet plate 30.8 x 23.6 at 379.6, 12.1 and the C14 in it; a serial label (a QR code and three lines) above the socket; three edge screws at 11.1, 221.7 and 431.9, y 37.4; five vent slots along the top. The rating label at the right carries the model text. The small legend beside the RPS lamp reads USP RPS, OFF and ON. A line of rating text under the inlet has one unreadable digit and is left out.

rps.note: Data sheet, LEDs: "RPS: Status" with no colour or state; the page says "Redundancy: DC Power Backup, with UniFi RPS". The lamp is the blue triangle left of the USP RPS socket in the elevation; its colour is the estimated one in rps-lamp-colour. The socket is seated as ubiquiti/usp-rps-input@1, which presents the registered key ubiquiti-usp-rps; the plug that enters it is ubiquiti/usp-rps-plug@1, estimated, and no sheet names the cable.

rps-lamp-colour.note: estimated - the triangle left of the USP RPS socket is blue in the community rear elevation, so the lamp carries one lit state, blue. The data sheet gives no state for it, so the state is named for its colour and not for a meaning.

sfp.note: Two cages stacked in one column, each lamp a small white triangle between them: up for the upper cage and down for the lower. The sheet's LED table says "SFP+: Speed/link/activity" with no colours, so the lamps keep the component's on and off.

sources.note: Ubiquiti data sheet "Datasheet USW-Pro-24-PoE" (two pages, © 2023 Ubiquiti Inc., PDF created 2023-03-08; https://dl.ui.com/ds/usw-pro-24-poe_ds.pdf): the Mechanical and Hardware tables and the LEDs table, and its faceplate photograph (1053 x 228 px, a three-quarter view). The maker's techspecs.ui.com page data for the model (https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/switching/usw-pro-24-poe, read 2026-10-26): Form Factor "Rack mount (1U)", dimensions, port layout, supported rack depth. The NetBox community devicetype-library entry USW-Pro-24-PoE.yaml and its front and rear elevation drawings (netbox-community/devicetype-library, read 2026-10-26) are community work, not the maker's, and are used as a second opinion and, for positions, as the only straight-on drawing held. The install guide (dl.ui.com/qig/usw-pro-24-poe) is not held.

vents.note: estimated - five plain dark bars per face, at the places and sizes read off the community elevations (the data sheet strip shows the same five bars on the front, plain and straight). They are plain rectangles that declare `vent`, not a perforated `pattern: vent` field: a field of 1.0 mm cells in a bar 1.8 mm high drew as a zig-zag.
